name: oss-free-audit
tagline_zh: 白嫖开源前先问一句：谁在为免费买单？输入仓库路径或链接，自动查许可证、扒金主、嗅数据买卖信号。
tagline_en: Before you build on free, find out who pays. Paste a repo path/URL, get license lineage, sponsor map, and.
desc_en: Audit any free or open-source repository to answer "who pays for this being free?" and whether it is safe to build on. Input is a local path, a GitHub URL, or uploaded repository files. why_zh: 同类只查许可证，它把代码背后的商业链和遥测信号摊开，让你看清免费背后的真实代价。
why_en: Others check licenses; this one maps the business chain and telemetry signals behind the code, revealing the true cost of free.
